lines.text: The next day, after school.
I call Amy to an empty classroom.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hi. You wanted to see me?
Oh, Amy. You're here.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I was surprised when you asked to meet in a classroom.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I thought we'd go to the teachers' office or a counseling room or something.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I even thought I might end up somewhere more serious, since I raised my voice at you...
Look, you're not in trouble.
I didn't want you to feel pressured, so I chose somewhere you'd be comfortable.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... I've always thought this, but you're really kind.
Me? You think?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: You're a famous commander, and you're also the assistant homeroom teacher.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: At first, it was really uncomfortable having you here. It was intimidating.
But not now?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yeah. I realized you treat everyone kindly, no matter who you're dealing with.
In that case, do you mind if we talk openly about what happened yesterday?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: You want me to participate in the festival, don't you?
Well... that's part of it, of course.
But I also wanted to hear your thoughts.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: My thoughts...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Honestly, I'll probably end up joining the festival.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: The school's already decided to go through with it. Nothing's going to change just because a lone student like me objects.
Even so, I'd like you to actually enjoy your experience with it.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: How should I put this...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I don't know if I can enjoy it.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: When I first came to this school, I was really scared.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I wondered if I'd be able to do well, or even keep up...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: But it ended up being much different from what I expected.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: We all laugh a lot, and chat, and joke around...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: We hang out after school together and get good food...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: We get sleepy in class, and hate when the teachers give us homework...
It's all very normal, right?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yeah, it's been really normal.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... And that's the thing. If I keep this up, I'll really feel like I'm just a normal student.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm afraid I'll get hurt later.
Amy, you really are a normal student, first and foremost. That comes before being a Nikke.
You have the right to enjoy a normal, happy school life.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: That's true, isn't it?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Since you're the one who said it, it must be true, right?
Yeah. Trust me.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'll try to enjoy the festival too.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Thank you.
After that, we chat a bit longer,
and Amy leaves looking much more relaxed than before.
A gentle breeze drifts through the classroom as the sun sets.
Privaty walks over from the classroom next door.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That went just as I expected.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I knew you had to be the one to talk to her.
I wonder if that takes care of it...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Probably not.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I managed to convince the admin office to replace one midterm with the festival and its preparations.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That means we have to make it a really fun festival.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Both for the students, including Amy,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: and for everyone else who comes to visit the school. We have to ensure everyone has a great time.
Yeah. We can do this.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You bet we can!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: After all, I'm the greatest homeroom teacher here, and you're the greatest assistant homeroom teacher.
Privaty clenches her fists, her expression resolute.
I couldn't help but find it unbearably cute.
Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yes?
Want to go grab a drink?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: D-drink...?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: In your room?
Yeah. I stocked the fridge so we can drink anytime.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: In that case, I'm in.
*Gulp, gulp*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ahhh...
Hm? You're drinking really slowly today.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-is that so?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I guess I kinda... feel a little unsettled...
Huh? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's just...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-I've never had a drink alone with a man in his room before...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The whole room smells like you...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And you said it yourself, didn't you? You never know what might happen when a man and woman get drunk together.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I keep having all these thoughts... It's making it hard to drink a lot.
Come to think of it, she's not wrong.
Here she is, looking just a little tipsy, her face slightly flushed.
We both know something could happen.
Is she giving me a sign? I think so...
She wants me to stop hesitating and make a move.
I gently bring the back of my hand to Privaty's cheek.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what...?!
*Thunk* *Glug, glug, glug*
Uh-oh...
Privaty has dropped the beer she was holding,
and now her clothes are completely soaked.
Are you okay?!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Agh... Ahhh!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm sorry...
Do you want to take a shower?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what...?!
Oh, no... I mean... The smell is pretty strong, and I'm guessing you're feeling pretty sticky right now.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh... Well... Yeah, if you don't mind, I'll go ahead and borrow your shower...
*Shhhhhh*
I lay out the largest pieces of clothing I have in front of the shower room.
Then I start drinking by myself in an attempt to clear my head.
*Gulp, gulp*
*Shhhhhh*
*Squeak, squeak*
The water stops.
I hear the soft sound of a towel rubbing skin.
*Click*
The door opens slightly.
Whew...!
You all done?
I turn around, trying to act casual.
Privaty is standing there, wearing my clothes.
Wh-what about the pants? I thought I left them too...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: They were too big... They kept slipping down.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: D-do I look weird...?
No. Not at all.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, good.
Privaty gets her hair mostly dry with a towel and sits back beside me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Shall we keep drinking?
Yeah, let's do it.
An awkward silence ensues,
filled only with the scent of my shampoo and body wash,
and the sound of beer being sipped.
... By the way, why are you holding your arms like that?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Huh? Oh...
Ever since she came out of the shower, Privaty's been holding her arms in front of her as though she's uncomfortable.
Even now, she's gripping her beer with both hands.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Th-the...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The beer I spilled earlier soaked all the way into my underwear...
What does that have to do with your arms?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, come on...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Sometimes you're so perceptive, and other times you're completely clueless...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm doing this so nothing shows!
So nothing shows?
What do you mean?
I naturally look at what she's covering.
Your chest...?
Ah, ahhh...!
I feel the alcohol rush to my head.
I-I'm sorry! I didn't even think about it...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: No, it's my fault for spilling the beer.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And besides...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... You never know what might happen when a man and woman get drunk together.
My mind clears, and my senses sharpen.
I reach out and place my hand on the nape of Privaty's neck.
Water droplets from her wet hair soak into my hand.
As our bodies touch, I feel a softness that a single thin T-shirt can't conceal.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what're you...?
So, Privaty... are you drunk?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... I think I am.
Me too.
The awkward silence from before is completely gone,
replaced by the sound of empty cans rolling,
and our breathing filling the room.
After that day, having a drink together in one of our room's becomes our routine.
We very naturally start going back and forth between each other's rooms.
Then, a few days later...
The M.M.R. Vocational School officially begins preparing for the festival.
2x2 Love: Privaty - True Ending (2)
